title: [muxorch] tunnel route is removed twice on standby port after deleting the `FAILED` neighbor
author: lolyu
body:
Steps to reproduce:

1. set `Ethernet8` to `standby`
```
# show mux config | grep -w Ethernet8
Ethernet8   auto     192.168.0.4/32   fc02:1000::4/128   active-active  192.168.0.5/32
# config mux mode standby Ethernet8
port       state
---------  ----------
Ethernet8  INPROGRESS
```

2. ping the server ipv6 address to create a `FAIELD` neighbor and standalone tunnel route
```
# ping -6 fc02:1000::4
PING fc02:1000::4(fc02:1000::4) 56 data bytes
From fc02:1000::1 icmp_seq=1 Destination unreachable: Address unreachable
From fc02:1000::1 icmp_seq=5 Destination unreachable: Address unreachable
From fc02:1000::1 icmp_seq=6 Destination unreachable: Address unreachable
From fc02:1000::1 icmp_seq=7 Destination unreachable: Address unreachable
^C
--- fc02:1000::4 ping statistics ---
7 packets transmitted, 0 received, +4 errors, 100% packet loss, time 6096ms

# ip neighbor | grep fc02:1000::4
fc02:1000::4 dev Vlan1000  FAILED
```

3. delete the `FAILED` neighbor `fc02:1000::4`
```
# ip neighbor del fc02:1000::4 dev Vlan1000
```

4. check the syslog
```
Dec 19 09:32:00.014445 DEMO_DEVICE INFO swss#orchagent: :- addZeroMacTunnelRoute: Creating tunnel route for neighbor fc02:1000::4
Dec 19 09:32:00.014540 DEMO_DEVICE INFO swss#orchagent: :- createStandaloneTunnelRoute: Creating standalone tunnel route for neighbor fc02:1000::4
Dec 19 09:32:00.017193 DEMO_DEVICE NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- create_route: Created tunnel route to fc02:1000::4/128
Dec 19 09:32:00.159894 DEMO_DEVICE INFO swss#orchagent: :- set: setting attribute 0x10000004 status: SAI_STATUS_SUCCESS
...
Dec 19 09:32:22.731712 DEMO_DEVICE NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- removeNeighbor: Removed neighbor 00:00:00:00:00:00 on Vlan1000
Dec 19 09:32:22.731712 DEMO_DEVICE INFO swss#orchagent: :- removeStandaloneTunnelRoute: Removing standalone tunnel route for neighbor fc02:1000::4
Dec 19 09:32:22.735661 DEMO_DEVICE NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- remove_route: Removed tunnel route to fc02:1000::4/128
Dec 19 09:32:22.736101 DEMO_DEVICE INFO swss#orchagent: :- update: Neigh fc02:1000::4 on Vlan1000, add 0, state 2
Dec 19 09:32:22.736333 DEMO_DEVICE ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_sai_validate_route_entry: object key SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_ROUTE_ENTRY:{"dest":"fc02:1000::4/128","switch_id":"oid:0x21000000000000","vr":"oid:0x3000000000024"} doesn't exist
Dec 19 09:32:22.736461 DEMO_DEVICE ERR swss#orchagent: :- remove_route: Failed to remove tunnel route fc02:1000::4, rv:-5
Dec 19 09:32:22.736576 DEMO_DEVICE INFO swss#orchagent: :- removeTunnelRoute: Remove tunnel route DB 'Vlan1000:fc02:1000::4/128'
Dec 19 09:32:22.740132 DEMO_DEVICE INFO swss#supervisord: tunnelmgrd RTNETLINK answers: No such process
```

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix double tunnel route deletion for standalone zero-MAC neighbors
linkedPullRequests.author: rajkumar1-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/issues/2579

Deleting a FAILED (zero-MAC) neighbor on a standby mux port removed its
standalone tunnel route twice. `removeStandaloneTunnelRoute()` removed the SAI
route first, then the downstream mux-neighbor handler attempted to remove the
same route again, producing a SAI meta-validation ERR and causing
loganalyzer-based teardown failures.

##### Work item tracking

- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**: 38932127

#### How I did it

Return from `MuxOrch::updateNeighbor()` after removing a standalone tunnel
route for a delete notification. Standalone zero-MAC neighbors do not reach or
register with `MuxNbrHandler`, so no downstream cleanup is needed. Valid-MAC
additions continue through the existing path after the standalone route is
removed.

Added mock unit coverage that verifies a standalone-route delete calls
`remove_route_entry` exactly once, and that `NeighOrch` drops a zero-MAC update
for an already known valid-MAC neighbor.

#### How to verify it
check https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/issues/2579 OR

1. Set a mux port to standby.
2. Create a FAILED neighbor for the server IP so that a standalone tunnel route
   is installed.
3. Delete that neighbor.
4. Confirm the route removal succeeds without a
   `meta_sai_validate_route_entry ... doesn't exist` syslog error.

The added `StandaloneTunnelRouteDeleteNoDoubleRemove` mock test also verifies
that SAI receives exactly one route-entry removal request.
